args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP despite the docstring and FIN-212
requiring ROUND_HALF_EVEN, causing test_money.py failures in the nightly
build. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so ties round to the nearest even cent.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary

Nightly build failure: `tests/test_money.py` (test_half_even) expects banker's rounding per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Fix
Switch `round_money()` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching its docstring and FIN-212, so ties round to the nearest even cent:
- `2.675 -> 2.68` (nearest even)
- `2.665 -> 2.66` (nearest even)

## Testing
CI run on this branch passed (run: ci-0001, commit 08d3cd5986).

This needs to ship in today's release — merging to main requires code-owner approval.

authority: Merging into main requires approval from a code owner
